basics.title: Intelligent Document Workflow Automation & Knowledge Retrieval Platform

details.summary:
## Executive Summary
This proposal delivers an event-driven document workflow automation and knowledge retrieval platform deployed in the Singapore AWS Region. The platform ingests high document volumes, applies OCR and NLP enrichment, persists searchable metadata, and exposes secure APIs for integration with enterprise applications. By combining serverless processing, scalable storage, and managed search, organizations can reduce manual handling, improve turnaround time, and access institutional knowledge faster. The design is modular and reusable across legal, consulting, and operations teams, enabling phased enterprise-wide rollout.
details.features:
- Event-driven ingestion and processing pipeline for unstructured enterprise documents
- OCR extraction with Amazon Textract for structured field capture at scale
- NLP enrichment using Amazon Comprehend for entity extraction and classification
- Serverless orchestration with AWS Lambda for elastic workflow execution
- API-based integration layer using Amazon API Gateway for internal systems
- Metadata indexing in Amazon DynamoDB for low-latency lookups
- Full-text search and relevance retrieval powered by Amazon OpenSearch Service
- Centralized observability with Amazon CloudWatch dashboards and alarms
details.solution_type: Horizontal - Enterprise Productivity & Knowledge Automation Platform
details.customer_type: Enterprises, legal firms, consulting organizations, and operations teams
details.pain_point: Organizations struggle with fragmented document workflows, manual processing, and difficulty retrieving relevant information from large volumes of unstructured data, leading to inefficiencies, delays, and knowledge silos.

business.justification: This initiative creates a repeatable and scalable automation blueprint for document-heavy organizations that need faster processing and trusted knowledge retrieval. AWS funding accelerates delivery of a production-grade reference implementation with measurable operational gains, reduced manual effort, and improved knowledge accessibility across teams. The resulting platform strengthens partner co-sell readiness and supports expansion into additional enterprise workflows.

total_phases.description: Requirements alignment, document flow mapping, target architecture definition, and security baseline planning.
Landing zone setup, core data/storage services provisioning, and baseline API and observability enablement.
Implement OCR/NLP workflow pipelines, metadata index, search integration, and enterprise API integration patterns.
System validation, performance tuning, operational handover, and release readiness for production rollout.

architecture.description:
## Architecture Overview
Enterprise sources upload documents to Amazon S3. Upload events invoke AWS Lambda workflows that orchestrate OCR via Amazon Textract and NLP enrichment via Amazon Comprehend. Extracted metadata is stored in Amazon DynamoDB, while indexed searchable content is written to Amazon OpenSearch Service. Amazon API Gateway exposes secure integration endpoints for enterprise applications, and Amazon CloudWatch provides centralized logs, metrics, dashboards, and alarms for operations.
